name: Atlas AS7-D — silhouette study
notes: NEW silhouette-only manual cross-section sculpture. No inherited coarse geometry, no detail pass, no 100k voxel budget. References listed in docs/graphics/component-shape-study.md Shape review 2: shortened and seated skull, removed fake giant chest ports, reduced missile/gun projections; thinner frontal thigh. Reference iteration 3: original stock AS7-D broad faceted torso hoods, recessed skull between shoulders, angular shoulder taper; 10-vertex individually drawn hull sections instead of rounded octagonal templates. Reference iteration 4: explicitly planar shoulder caps, elliptical-but-angular combat gauntlets, knee shields, tapered greaves and wide toed armored boots; right arm mirrors left. Fifth pass: broad chest avoids sharp waist taper; new separate pelvic cuirass and center codpiece connect torso and thigh roots. Pass 6: separate hollow right torso autocannon muzzle shroud rather than tiny projecting rod. Pass 7: a separate skull jaw and palms with close-in knuckles replace unarticulated mitten-shaped fists. Shape pass 9: larger flat-topped skull with pronounced brow, cheeks and angular jaw; rising tapered shoulder shells; athletic scale relative to Jenner and Wolverine. References AS7-D tabletop render and AS7-D fan CAD sculpture. Pass 10: visibly framed five-tube torso launcher; long beveled front kneecaps with a separate structural silhouette rather than amorphous circles.
